entities.name: A0A0D2L718
observations: Reviewed Hypholoma sublateritium delta(6)-protoilludene synthase; exact sequence match to query.
Catalyzes cyclization of farnesyl diphosphate to delta(6)-protoilludene.
Requires Mg2+ and is assigned EC 4.2.3.135; GO:0010333 terpene synthase activity.

entities.name: FPP to delta(6)-protoilludene
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:34695 and EC 4.2.3.135.
The enzyme-mediated process is a Mg2+-dependent terpene cyclization involving ionization of the diphosphate ester and cyclization of the resulting farnesyl cation.

entities.name: Ethosuximide
observations: PubChem CID 3291; formula C7H11NO2; 3-ethyl-3-methylpyrrolidine-2,5-dione; marketed succinimide anticonvulsant for absence seizures.

Documented adverse-effect domains include gastrointestinal, nervous-system, psychiatric, skin/hypersensitivity, hematologic, hepatobiliary, immune, renal, respiratory, musculoskeletal, eye, ear, cardiac, vascular, metabolic, and pregnancy-related effects.

entities.name: Ethosuximide adverse SOCs
observations: Labeling and safety sources report nausea, vomiting, abdominal symptoms, neurologic effects, psychiatric effects, rash and severe cutaneous reactions, blood dyscrasias, hypersensitivity, liver abnormalities, and rare renal, respiratory, cardiac, ear, eye, vascular, and musculoskeletal manifestations.
Pregnancy exposure has fetal-risk relevance; congenital effects are treated as a potential exposure-associated category rather than a common adult adverse reaction.
